title: Korea Caregiver Debt Splitter
oneLiner: A family care-cost room that shows Korean siblings the monthly caregiver burn, debt risk, and fair contribution plan before resentment explodes.
theme: 건강 / 자산 방어 / 외로움 - aging parent urgency, sibling fairness, caregiver debt, and emotional load.
stitchPrompt: Build a calm consumer web app prototype called "Korea Caregiver Debt Splitter" for Korean adult children coordinating a parent's caregiver costs and sibling contributions. The first screen must be a working family care-cost room with a monthly care burn header, care schedule builder, sibling capacity table, insurance/subsidy checklist, fair-split simulator, conflict log, and family meeting packet. Use realistic sample data: 3.7M won monthly private caregiver quote, hospital discharge deadline, three siblings with different income and distance, long-term-care grade uncertainty, parent savings, night-shift gaps, and one sibling refusing equal payment. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with warm neutral surfaces, reassuring step flows, gentle warning accents, and emotionally steady language for a painful family money conversation. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
